message: flux-rs lane coverage gap: proof-seeds.jsonl places 'flux' in suggested_layers for PS-vb-qxjgx-001 (POST-001), PS-vb-qxjgx-003 (POST-003), and PS-vb-qxjgx-011 (POST-011), but the verifier-lane-decisions.jsonl files exactly ONE flux-rs row (VLD-QXJGX-012, blocked_tooling, POST-011). POST-001 (id bijection, RecordKind::StepSucceeded.id()==33) and POST-003 (is_known_record_kind(33)==true) get kani only and have no flux-rs lane decision at all (required/not_applicable/blocked_tooling). Per references/verification-lane-policy.md, 'No verifier is silently omitted: if a profile requires a verifier, the lane decision is required, not_applicable, or blocked_tooling with reviewer acceptance.' Recommended fix is to add explicit not_applicable flux-rs rows citing (a) global flux-rs unavailability (vb-b8i8f), (b) kani exhaustive coverage via kani::any() over u16, (c) literal-sync covered by PO-QXJGX-007. The underlying substantive coverage is sound (kani covers POST-001/POST-003 exhaustively and proptest literal-sync covers POST-011), but the policy expects per-clause explicit decisions.
required_fix: Append two verifier-lane-decision/v1 rows: VLD-QXJGX-013 (flux-rs, not_applicable, POST-001) and VLD-QXJGX-014 (flux-rs, not_applicable, POST-003), each with non_applicability_evidence_refs=[constraints/coordination/vb-b8i8f, validation.rs kani full-sweep reference, PO-QXJGX-007 literal-sync cross-ref]. Reviewer disposition: accept with owner-approved-no-action by reviewer (current reviewer), affirming the substantive coverage is sound.
approval_ref: references/verification-lane-policy.md (kani exhaustive for pure predicates) + constraints/coordination/vb-b8i8f (global flux-rs unavailability)
rationale: The substantive coverage is sound: (1) the contract's risk profile excludes Verus entirely per NON-GOALS, (2) the contract's chosen verifier modes are kani+proptest+flux per delivery-scope.jsonl, (3) flux-rs is globally unavailable per vb-b8i8f (codec/mod.rs:184-186 explicitly comments out pub mod flux_validation), and (4) POST-001/POST-003 are pure match predicates where kani::any() over u16 sweeps the entire input space. The 'kani exhaustiveness + global flux unavailability' rationale covers the missing flux-rs rows; the implementation team can add them in a low-priority audit pass. No blocker.
